also_preserved_in: backups/wsl_freeze_20260923_180202/trm-rust_source.tar.gz -- verified by listing the archive: all of these (and font8x8.bin, which swarm-boot/src/main.rs:30 include_bytes!s) are inside it; only target/ build output is excluded, and that is reproducible from the archived source.

build_requirement.this_host: no g++ and no cl (measured); the Hermes runtime ships llama.dll at AppData/Local/hermes/runtimes/llamacpp/b10964/cuda/ but no llama.h
build_requirement.to_rebuild: these are llama.cpp examples (they #include "llama.h"): build them against a llama.cpp checkout, which the WSL side has (g++ 15 present there, no cargo needed). Harvested as SOURCE with a stated build path, not claimed as built.

identity_finding: ref_hidden.bin, hidden_state.bin and field_qwen.bin are ONE file (identical sha256) under three names -- the qwen 1024-dim hidden state. field_bonsai.bin is a distinct 5120-dim vector.

capture_hidden.cpp.what: reads the final-layer hidden state (the voltage representation) before the output softmax via llama_get_embeddings_ith and prints it as f32.

capture_layers.cpp.what: captures the hidden states after EACH block, so the Rust forward is verified per-layer rather than in one giant run: binary [n_layers+1][1024] f32.

voltage_node.cpp.what: the GPU fast-path voltage node: llama.cpp CUDA runs the real forward, reads the hidden state, and the verified K3 collapse produces the action vector (no CPU matmul re-derivation). Writes hidden_state.bin (1024 f32) and prints the K3 action vector.

voltage_node_offload.cpp.what: the same node for models that do not fully fit (a 3.8 GB Bonsai against an 8 GB card with backend load): takes <model> <n_gpu_layers> <n_tokens> <tok>...

measured.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Laptop GPU, compute capability 8.6, VMM: yes, VRAM: 8191 MiB
measured.note: parsed from ref_hidden.log, i.e. a run log rather than a declaration: the model the captures came from, how many tensors it loaded, and on which device

fabric_report.txt.what: v18-era DECLARED fabric state (trit count 170757175, codec 2) -- historical, not the live 153,523,394

fabric_report_ensemble.txt.what: the ensemble variant of the same v18 report

field_qwen.bin.what: identical to both: the qwen field

hidden_state.bin.what: identical to ref_hidden.bin: what voltage_node.cpp writes

ref_hidden.bin.what: the reference hidden state (1024 f32, all nonzero, min -28.319275 / max 12.265035)

ref_hidden.log.what: the full run log (CUDA init, device, model load, capture)

why: these four instruments were UNTRACKED in a WSL llama.cpp fork (git ls-files --others showed them, and v19 named them only in docs, never in code), so they had no other copy; their captures were git-IGNORED in ~/trm-rust, which the reconciliation manifest classified as the instrument's other half -- the reference the Rust forward is verified against
